title: Item Components Block Placer
description: Sets the item as a placer item component for blocks. Items with this component will place a block when used.

aligned_placement.title: Aligned Placement
aligned_placement.description: If true, block placement through this item will be aligned while holding the interaction button down. Defaults to false.

block.title: Block
block.description:
Defines the block that will be placed.

Sample values:
• my_sword_singing: minecraft:dirt

replace_block_item.title: Replace Block Item
replace_block_item.description: If true, the item will be registered as the item for this block. This item will be returned by default when the block is broken/picked. Note: the identifier for this item must match the block's identifier for this field to be valid. Defaults to false.

use_on.title: use_on
use_on.description:
List of block descriptors of the blocks that this item can be used on. If left empty, all blocks will be allowed.

Properties:
• name (string) = 
• states (int) = {}
• tags (string) = 

Sample values:
• my_sword_singing: ["dirt","grass","anvil"]
